### 1 — Scene
This appears to be a Mexican-style meal: an egg/omelet-like main portion with green salsa, white rice, pico de gallo, and a little shredded white cheese. Strong sunlight makes the main portion somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The area shares below total **50% of the plate**, approximately the visible food coverage. Overlapping ingredients are assigned separate footprint shares to avoid counting the same area twice.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked white rice | 12% | 64 cm² × 2 cm = 128 ml | 0.8 | 102 g | 130 | 133 kcal |
| Egg/omelet-like portion | 14% | 74 cm² × 1.5 cm = 111 ml | 0.95 | 106 g | 190 | 201 kcal |
| Green salsa | 9% | 48 cm² × 0.6 cm = 29 ml | 1.0 | 29 g | 40 | 12 kcal |
| Pico de gallo: tomato, onion, herbs | 13% | 69 cm² × 1.3 cm = 90 ml | 0.6 | 54 g | 30 | 16 kcal |
| Shredded white cheese | 2% | 11 cm² × 0.6 cm = 6.6 ml | 0.9 | 6 g | 350 | 21 kcal |

No distinct pool of oil is visible; cooking fat is included in the egg portion’s energy estimate.

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 297 g and 383 kcal** is plausible for this moderately filled plate. The largest uncertainty is the identity of the sauce-covered main portion.
